name: Ambedkar Memorial Park
description: Sprawling 107-acre park in red sandstone with monuments dedicated to social reformers. Night illumination.

name: Aminabad Market
description: Famous for chikankari embroidery, ittar (perfume), and the legendary Lucknowi kebabs and biryani.

name: Bara Imambara
description: Colossal 18th-century Shia assembly hall with the famous Bhool Bhulaiya labyrinth. Largest unsupported vaulted structure.

name: Chhota Imambara
description: Opulent 1838 congregation hall with Belgian chandeliers, gilt-edged mirrors, and calligraphy. "Palace of Lights".

name: Hazratganj
description: Heritage shopping boulevard of Lucknow. Boutiques, restaurants, and colonial architecture.

name: Rumi Darwaza
description: Iconic 60-ft Awadhi gateway modeled on a Turkish gate in Istanbul. Symbol of Lucknow.

name: The Residency
description: Ruins of the British compound besieged during the 1857 revolt. Museum and gardens with colonial history.

name: Cave Garden (Eco Cave)
description: Interconnected caves named after animals (bat cave, tiger cave). Adventure crawl for kids. Musical fountain show.

name: High Altitude Zoo
description: India's highest zoo at 6,900 ft housing snow leopard, Himalayan bear, Siberian tiger, and red panda.

name: Mall Road Nainital
description: Bustling lakeside promenade with shops, restaurants, and candle sellers. Heart of Nainital social life.

name: Naina Devi Temple
description: Sacred temple on the banks of Naini Lake. One of the 51 Shakti Peethas — eyes of Sati fell here.

name: Naini Lake
description: Crescent-shaped natural lake at 6,358 ft. Boating, Mall Road promenade, and mountain reflections.

name: Snow View Point
description: Cable car ride to 7,500 ft for panoramic views of Nanda Devi, Trishul, and other Himalayan peaks.

name: Tiffin Top (Dorothy's Seat)
description: Hilltop viewpoint at 7,520 ft offering 360-degree views. Named after English painter Dorothy Kellett.

name: Aina Mahal (Mirror Palace)
description: 18th-century palace with Venetian glass, mirrors, and tilework. Built by a craftsman trained in Europe by the Kutch Maharao.

name: Ajrakhpur Block Printing Village
description: Village specializing in the ancient ajrakh printing technique. Watch artisans stamp intricate patterns on fabric.

name: Bhujodi Weaving Village
description: Living craft village where every family weaves. Buy shawls, blankets, and bags directly from master weavers.

name: Hodka Village
description: Bhunga (circular mud hut) village with stunning mirror-work walls. Homestays available. Near the Rann edge.

name: Prag Mahal
description: Italian Gothic palace from 1865 with the tallest tower in Kutch. Grand Darbar Hall and Jain temple views from roof.

name: Jungle Safari
description: Drive-through zoo with indigenous wildlife — lions, tigers, leopards, deer, and bear in natural habitats.

name: Sardar Sarovar Dam
description: India's second largest dam. View from the statue area shows the full scale of this Narmada mega-project.

name: Statue of Unity Viewing Gallery
description: Chest-level viewing gallery at 153 meters offering 360° views of the Narmada Valley, Satpura, and Vindhya ranges.

name: Valley of Flowers
description: Landscaped garden below the statue with seasonal flower displays and walking paths.

name: Gurdwara Shri Hemkund Sahib
description: Star-shaped Sikh shrine at 4,329m, commemorating Guru Gobind Singh's previous incarnation per the Dasam Granth. Open late May to early October; winters are snowbound.

name: Hemkund Sarovar (lake)
description: The glacial lake beside the Gurdwara — pilgrims take a ritual dip in its near-freezing waters. Seven peaks ring the lake, giving the destination its 'Hemkund' (lake of snow) name.

name: Lakshman Temple
description: Small Hindu shrine beside the Gurdwara, associated with the Ramayana legend of Lakshman meditating here after the war. Both Sikh and Hindu pilgrims visit as a pair.

name: Dwarkadhish Temple
description: Richly painted temple from 1814 with intricate carvings. Main festival temple during Holi and Janmashtami.

name: Government Museum Mathura
description: Outstanding collection of Mathura-school sculptures from 3rd century BC. Kushan and Gupta period masterpieces.

name: Shri Krishna Janmabhoomi
description: Birthplace of Lord Krishna. Temple built at the exact prison cell site. One of India's most sacred sites.

name: Nokrek Biosphere Reserve Visitor Centre
description: UNESCO-recognized biosphere reserve. Home to rare Khasi wild orange trees and clouded leopards. Visitor information and guide services.

name: Nokrek National Park
description: UNESCO Biosphere Reserve. Home to red panda and Hoolock gibbon. Origin of the wild citrus (memang narang).

name: Tura Weekly Market
description: Vibrant tribal market every Sunday. Garo crafts, local produce, betel leaf, and traditional wear.

name: Jama Masjid Champaner
description: UNESCO masterpiece. Prototype for all Mughal mosques — perfect proportions, carved minarets, jali screens.

name: Kalika Mata Temple (Pavagadh)
description: Shakti Peeth on Pavagadh hilltop. Ropeway + 250 steps. Panoramic views of Gujarat plains from the summit.

name: Anasakti Ashram
description: Where Mahatma Gandhi stayed in 1929 and wrote Anasakti Yoga. Panoramic views of Trishul, Nanda Devi, Panchachuli.

name: Kausani Tea Estate
description: Uttarakhand's only tea garden at 5,600 ft. Walk through plantations and buy organic Kausani tea.

name: Coral Reef Walk
description: Walk on exposed coral reef at low tide. Octopus, sea horses, pufferfish, and anemones visible in shallow pools.

name: Pirotan Island
description: Island with nesting birds, tidal flats, and mangroves. Accessible by boat. Flamingos in winter.

name: Prashar Lake Campsite
description: Camping spot at 8,900 ft with the lake, temple, and Dhauladhar and Kinnaur Kailash views.

name: Prashar Rishi Temple
description: Three-tiered pagoda temple at Prashar Lake dedicated to sage Prashar. Floating island in the lake.

name: Korzok Monastery
description: Highest monastery in Ladakh on the shores of Tso Moriri. Ancient gompa with Buddhist murals.

name: Tso Moriri Lake
description: High-altitude lake at 15,075 ft — Ramsar wetland site. Breeding ground for black-necked cranes and bar-headed geese.

name: Chaukori Tea Garden
description: Small tea estate at 6,500 ft with stunning views of Panch Chuli and Nanda Devi peaks.

name: Gurudongmar Lake
description: One of the highest lakes in the world at 17,800 ft. Sacred to Sikhs and Buddhists. Part never freezes.

name: Shatrunjaya Hill Temples
description: 863 Jain temples on one hill, built over 900 years. 3,500+ steps to the summit. Most sacred Jain pilgrimage on Earth.

name: Umling La Pass
description: World's highest motorable pass at 19,024 ft. BRO-maintained road to this extreme altitude record.
